ALL.reconciliation_362s_vs_180s_h2: H2 predicts whether a flip occurs WITHIN 180s from observation t, but persistent Q4 requires 60s of prior continuous residence. While 45.8% of persistent Q4 regimes flip within 180s, the right tail contains long transition regimes (median 195s, p75 445s, p90 890s) that elevate the parametric mean to 362s.
